title: GEC Wayanad Project Data Schema
description: Formal JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 specification for validating institutional project records in the GEC Wayanad Project Showcase Portal, aligned with RO-Crate graph metadata structures.

graph.description: An array of graph entities representing projects and institutional records.

graphEntity.description: Base entity structure within the graph array. Every entity must specify a non-empty id and type.

id.description: Unique non-empty identifier for the entity.

type.description: The entity classification or schema type (e.g., Project, Person, Organization).

projectEntity.description: Detailed validation rules for records where type is Project.

title.description: The descriptive title of the project.

domain.description: The technical or academic application domain.

description.description: A comprehensive summary of the project goals and methodology.

year.description: The academic year of submission or prototype development.

department.description: The engineering department under which the project was conducted.

team.description: An array of student contributor reference IDs.

guide.description: Reference identifier for the supervising faculty guide.

technologies.description: An array of technology stacks, libraries, hardware, or tools utilized.
